data.long_meaning: The meaning of Lian is recorded in name-lists as “Liberated, Graceful”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Lian expresses “Liberated, Graceful”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lian total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_hebrew.name: ליאן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'lei' (to be lofty) and 'anah' (grace, favor) - God's lofty grace.

in_greek.name: Λιαν
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'lios' (graceful) and 'aner' (man) - graceful man.

in_latin.name: Lianus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'lians' (gracious) - gracious one.
